Investment Banking Compliance Review Assistant v1.0.0

- Initial release of AI-powered investment banking compliance assistant designed for the China market.
- Covers IPO sponsorship, M&A advisory, bond issuance, private equity investment, and ongoing compliance monitoring.
- Updated to reflect the latest CSRC/NASDAQ-style regulations, including AML, KYC, and cross-border compliance requirements.
- Provides compliance checklists, due diligence frameworks, and regulatory monitoring tools tailored for IBD compliance officers and deal teams.
- Bilingual support (English/Chinese), with industry-specific pain point analysis and clear trigger keyword sets.
